ABOUT QSC

Automotive care built on specialization

QSC's essence is one decision: do not put maintenance and painting in the same building. Each craft gets its own facility, team and equipment — unified by one QSC standard.

  1. Home
  2. About QSC

QSC Automotive serves owners of luxury and performance vehicles in Riyadh. The approach rests on three principles: assessment before repair, explanation before work, and documentation after completion. No promises we cannot keep, and no work the car does not need.

The first workshop is dedicated to mechanical and electrical maintenance and diagnostics; the second — the Fast Painting workshop — entirely to paint and body. That separation is not an organizational detail: dust is the enemy of paint, paint has no place near mechanical work, and each team masters its craft because it does nothing else.

PHOTO PENDING — QSC TEAM & FACILITIES

QSC's facilities span 4,500 square metres, staffed by 400 expert technicians serving around 50 vehicles daily — company-wide figures, shown as QSC publishes them. But the number we actually measure ourselves by is different: how many customers leave understanding exactly what happened to their car and why. A luxury vehicle is an investment and a relationship at once, and the workshop it deserves treats it as both — with specification-matched parts, decisions built on measurement rather than guesswork, and an invoice that tells the complete story of the work.

What we commit to on every visit

  • Documented diagnosis before any recommendation — no parts replaced on suspicion
  • A written scope and price you approve before work begins
  • Manufacturer-specification parts with full transparency on sourcing
  • A road test or verification check after every repair
  • A condition report that preserves your car's history and protects its value

Why two separate facilities?

Because quality starts with environment. Paint booths need filtered air, controlled humidity and complete isolation from sanding and metal dust; mechanical work needs lifts, measurement equipment and movement space incompatible with spray operations. Workshops that combine both under one roof inevitably compromise one — usually the paint. QSC chose the harder, correct path: a facility per craft, a team per facility, and one standard governing both.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How is QSC different from a dealership service center?

QSC is an independent specialist: it services to manufacturer schedules and procedures while answering to the owner, not a sales organization. Assessment before repair, explanation before work and documentation after completion apply to every car, every visit.

What do the company figures mean?

The published numbers — 4,500 m² of facilities, 400 expert technicians, 10,250 satisfied clients and 50 vehicles daily — are company-wide figures across QSC's operations, shown as published by QSC and never divided or inflated per branch.

Does QSC work on normal (non-luxury) cars?

The workshops are specialized around premium and performance vehicles — their equipment, parts routes and training are built for that. If you are unsure whether your car fits the scope, ask; you will get a straight answer.
